# braidworks keys

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

List strand types and who produces / consumes them. For the task this serves, see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/).

```text
usage: braidworks keys [-h] [--produces TYPE] [--consumes TYPE] [--format {human,json}]
                       [--only WEAVERS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --produces TYPE       only show this produced type.
  --consumes TYPE       only show this consumed type.
  --format {human,json}
  --only WEAVERS
```
